cards.card_text: Then comes the fortified city: deserted, a homestead abandoned, a wilderness forsaken.
cards.verse_text: For the fortified city lies deserted—a homestead abandoned, a wilderness forsaken.
cards.snippet: For the fortified city lies deserted—a homestead abandoned, a wilderness forsaken.

cards.card_text: “Oh, look upon us, we pray; we are all Your people!” Then the prayer looks around: God’s holy cities have become a wilderness, Zion a wasteland and Jerusalem a desolation.
cards.verse_text: Your holy cities have become a wilderness.
cards.snippet: Your holy cities have become a wilderness.

cards.card_text: And the LORD asks: Has He been a wilderness to Israel, or a land of dense darkness?
cards.verse_text: You people of this generation, consider the word of the LORD: “Have I been a wilderness to Israel or a land of dense darkness?
cards.snippet: …this generation, consider the word of the LORD: “Have I been a wilderness to Israel or a land of dense darkness?
